concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-transaction-find-node]] - Node.js transaction-ID lookup through callback or Promise, preserved results-limitation policy notice, missing-transaction error route, and Braintree Marketplace-specific escrow-status example
warnings: Preserve the page's results-limitation notice without interpreting the unread external PayPal Data Protection Addendum or claiming which result data is limited.
Keep the escrow-status route scoped to Braintree Marketplace transactions; do not generalize the example to all Braintree transactions.
Treat the shown escrowStatus value of held as an example, not as a guaranteed status for every found Marketplace transaction.
